what: A fixed bar stays hidden above until the first section (Hero) has passed, after that it drops from above over .75 beats, and when scrolling back it rises and hides again (phone dashboard bar)

options.bpm: Beat tempo — all lengths in beat units, default 142 (one beat .4225s)
options.after: Section to scroll past (selector), default the first section of main

from.where: index.js initTransport phone .strip (bar that appears after passing the Hero)
